name: kimi-codex-oauth
description: Reuse the local ChatGPT OAuth login (from Codex CLI, ~/.codex/auth.json) to call GPT models from Kimi Code via a local proxy.
author: P-A-N-52

interface.shortDescription: Reuse ChatGPT OAuth login (Codex CLI) to use GPT models in Kimi Code
interface.longDescription: Local, zero-dependency Node.js bridge for Kimi Code. Reuses Codex CLI file-based ChatGPT login, refreshes tokens, synchronizes model metadata, and provides validated configuration updates and reversible cleanup. Requires Node.js 18+ and a local Codex OAuth auth.json. See the repository for data handling, supported environments, and upgrade instructions.
